about: Orange County 2026 STATE income limits (HCD, Title 25 CCR 6932), by household size. Verified 2026-11-07 against the HCD memo dated June 23, 2026 (revised; it replaced the May 29, 2026 version), PDF page 11. These are State limits: HUD and State HOME limits can differ, so check which table a program uses. The earlier transcription (Irvine/Newport Beach pages) had the 4-person median as $136,600; the HCD PDF says $138,600. 'median' is HCD's median income adjusted for household size, used by HSC 50052.5 ('area median income adjusted for family size appropriate for the unit').
